summary: After parsing stops, ParserIterator retains Some(Done) or Some(Cut). An additional next() consumes that state without replacing it; a subsequent next() or finish() panics on unwrap(). The fix stores State directly and checks it without consuming it, preserving completion and error states. The verbatim reversal is identifiable, but no detecting upstream test was found at this commit: the fix adds no tests, and the existing iterator doctest only collects once and calls finish(), which does not trigger the bug. Repository-wide Rust source inspection found no test exercising repeated post-exhaustion calls. Leave this candidate blocked pending a suitable upstream test; no tests were executed.
